The [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] world of '''Byss''' was located in the [[Abyss system/Legends|Byss and Abyss system]] of [[The Slice/Legends|The Slice]].

==History==
Discovered between the [[Kymoodon Era]] and the [[Rianitus Period]], Byss was largely ignored in [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] trade, its one substantial export being the Abyssin themselves as [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]]. Located in space controlled by the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]] during the [[Jedi Civil War]], its space would be contested millennia later during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

During the [[Galactic War]], Byss was famous for its cheese.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=class|[[Voidhound|Smuggler]]|Bait|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref>

When the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] annexed the world, the slave trade on the planet was free to flow. with the old sanctions of the Republic lifted. After the fall of the Empire, the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] liberated the world, though the system was invaded by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] circa [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]]. As of [[137 ABY]], Byss was aligned with the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] Remnant.<ref name="TEA" />

==Geography==
Home to the one-eyed [[Abyssin/Legends|Abyssin]], the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] circled the [[Binary star/Legends|binary stars]] [[Byss (star)|Byss]] and [[Abyss/Legends|Abyss]] in an unusual figure-eight [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]]. A hot and arid planet, temperatures on Byss reached their unbearable apex when the planet passed between its two [[Star/Legends|suns]], a nightless period called "The Burning."

Much of the animal life of Byss either hibernated during the hottest part of Byss's year, or lived entirely underground. Byss's animals also evolved various systems to conserve [[Water/Legends|water]], such as the Abyssin ability to quickly regenerate from injuries to minimize blood loss. Most plant life on Byss utilized extensive taproots to extract underground water. One animal native to Byss was the [[gaunt]].

==Behind the scenes==
The PC game [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] mistakenly places Byss in the Farfin sector, a misspelling of the true [[Farrfin sector/Legends|Farrfin sector]], of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Galactic Core]].
